cards.front: Which ocular motor nerve is vulnerable to stretch in raised intracranial pressure because of its long, tethered intracranial course? [___]
cards.context:
After leaving the pons, the sixth nerve ascends along the clivus and passes over the petrous apex beneath the petrosphenoidal ligament in Dorello's canal.

Its long, tethered course makes it vulnerable to stretch when intracranial pressure rises.

cards.front: Which muscle group extends the knee? [___]
cards.context: Force passes through the quadriceps tendon to the patella, then through the patellar ligament to the tibial tuberosity.

cards.front: Which cranial nerve supplies the superior oblique muscle? [___]
cards.context: The superior oblique is supplied by cranial nerve IV. Its primary action is intorsion; depression is most useful for testing it when the eye is adducted.

cards.front: The motor nerve supplying sternocleidomastoid and trapezius is [___].
cards.context: These muscles turn the head and elevate the shoulder. Testing head rotation and shoulder shrug assesses the spinal accessory nerve.
